English or Korean is welcome. / 한국어와 영어 모두 가능합니다.
Please link public sources only and omit personal data, credentials and private logs.

## Question or concern
<!-- One specific question about the method, rather than a popularity or novelty claim. -->

## Source reference
<!-- File/function, commit, paper section or published artifact. -->

## Current interpretation
<!-- For example: LLM contribution, learned weight updates, model inputs/outputs,
data provenance, evaluation split, memory/termination boundaries, or search assistance. -->

## Evidence and alternative explanation
<!-- Separate observed facts from hypotheses. A related paper or counterexample is welcome.
Recorded prediction accuracy is not automatically physical success. -->

## Suggested check or clarification
<!-- Prefer a small offline check. No motor operation or new experiment is required. -->
